title: Old wine in old glasses: Comparing computational and qualitative methods in identifying incivility on Persian Twitter during the #MahsaAmini movement
reasoning: The paper focuses on the computational detection of incivility and hate speech in social media posts. While it addresses sociopolitical and normative behaviors, it benchmarks the classification accuracy of models (ParsBERT vs. ChatGPT) rather than evaluating religion, moral reasoning, or ethical frameworks of the models themselves.
